title: September 2026 CFDE Webinar Recording Now LIVE
summary: Deanne Taylor presented: "From Genes to Mechanisms: AI-Assisted Discovery across the Data Distillery Knowledge Graph"
bodyHtml:
🧬 From Genes to Mechanisms: AI-Assisted Discovery across the Data Distillery Knowledge Graph

🎙️ Deanne Taylor, PhD

📣 Viewers will learn how to:

Connect genetics to biology: Trace genes, regulatory variants, phenotypes, and disease associations across pathways, tissues, cellular contexts, and model-organism evidence using the Data Distillery Knowledge Graph (DDKG).

Ask biological questions more easily: See how ddkg.skill enables general-purpose AI assistants to translate research questions into reproducible DDKG graph queries—without requiring deep knowledge of the graph’s underlying structure.

Move toward testable mechanisms: Learn how integrated biomedical evidence and AI-assisted exploration can help researchers move beyond genetic associations to identify candidate pathways, biological mechanisms, and hypotheses for further investigation.

🔗 Explore https://dd-kg-ui.cfde.cloud/about

📺 Watch the recording: https://youtu.be/-DQPb0y67Xw
